title: S.R.O. 464(I)/2024 — Payment of subscription money (section 17(2))

source.name: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan

verification.note: Official Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan PDF shown as published updated to 15 March 2024. Check against the Gazette before quoting.

summary: Made under section 17(2) read with section 510: moneys payable by a subscriber under the memorandum and articles are payable in cash through a banking channel immediately after incorporation and within thirty days; share certificates (physical or book-entry) follow full payment; any impediment is reported to the registrar within thirty days.
